title: About AIVideosUGC: AI Product Photos and Video Ads
description: AIVideosUGC helps shop owners create product photos, short video ads, and presenter-led videos from a product image or page. Learn who operates the service and how it helps.
h1: Product Photos and Videos for Everyday Shop Work
lead: AIVideosUGC helps shop owners prepare product visuals for listings, campaigns, and social channels. Start with a product photo or page, shape the message, and review each result before sharing it.
start_note: See current plans and review the credit cost before creating.
secondary_keywords: AI product photos for online shops

sections.h2: Made for the Work Between Launches
paras: A new listing, seasonal promotion, or product update can call for fresh photos and video. AIVideosUGC gives shops one place to prepare those visuals from product information they already have.
Start with a product photo or public product page. Choose a scene or presenter, shape the message, and prepare an image or short video for your store and marketing channels.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a blonde chin-length bob holds a speckled mug on paper beside an open laptop.

sections.h2: A Clear Way to Prepare Product Visuals
paras: Bring together the product photo, the details shoppers need, and the channel where you plan to share the result.
Choose a format and creative direction, then review the wording, scenes, and visuals. You can revise the result before downloading it.
sections.alt: Adult shop owner gets one product ready for a listing at a packing table.

paras: Preview each result before you download it. Check that the product, labels, message, and visuals match what you intend to show.
Upload photos and voice material you own or have permission to use. Review your finished content and the rules of the channel before publishing.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a copper-red low bun sits by a closed laptop and a small brass padlock.

sections.h2: Know the Cost Before You Create
paras: You can see the credit cost for a photo or video job before you start it. Check the Pricing page for current plans and included credits.
If you have a question about an account, charge, or download, contact support@aivideosugc.com and include the page or file you need help with.

The service is shaped around familiar shop tasks: showing what an item looks like, explaining one useful detail, and preparing a version for a chosen channel.
Our goal is to make those steps easier to review and repeat, while leaving the product knowledge, final checks, and publishing decision with you.

faq.q: Can I make a creator-style clip of my product?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI actor, add your product, and make a creator-style video. You can review and adjust the message before downloading it.

faq.q: Can I use the same AI actor on my next ad?
faq.a: Yes. Choose the same AI actor for another video to keep a familiar look. You can change the script, voice, or product each time.

faq.q: Can I make shop ads without booking a studio?
faq.a: Yes. Start with a product photo or page, choose a scene or presenter, and review the result before you download it.
Visit the Pricing page for current plan options. You can see the credit cost for a photo or video job before it starts.

faq.q: Can I post the ad on my store and on social channels?
faq.a: You can download a result for your product page or social channels. Review your plan terms and each channel's rules before using it in a campaign.

faq.q: What can a shop make from one product photo?
faq.a: You can prepare listing photos, product videos, and short ads from product images or a public product page.

faq.q: Can my product video include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Add a voice and captions, then review the result before you download it.
